newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen set static in becalmed market.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen set static in becalmed market.

text.p: Danish share prices closed virtually unchanged on Wednesday in a quiet summer market and dealers said that they expected the market to remain becalmed.
"The market is dead as the biggest players near the end of the first-half of the year and don't want to take any risks that might spoil their interim results," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index closed a minimal 0.04 point down at 170.90 in overall bourse turnover of 1.089 billion crowns. The KFX June future fell 0.20 point to 171.00 with 893 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
BG Bank, SAS, Tele Danmark and ISS were the only KFX paper to close higher in a negative market.
BG Bank finished 2.5 percent or eight crowns up at 334 on a buy recommendation, while SAS finished 1.5 crown up at 72.50 and ISS attracted foreign investor interest to put on two to 237.
Tele Danmark edged up one crown to end at 351.
